output.summary: A small genus of edible and ornamental flowering plants in the amaranth family. Its colourful, flame-like flower heads may develop the crested form called cockscomb; one documented member, Celosia argentea var. argentea, is cooked as a leafy vegetable.
output.edibilityNote: The genus is described as edible; C. argentea var. argentea leaves, young stems and young flower clusters are cooked in stews.
